requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF alternate_qualified_person_used = true, THEN administration_permission_status = approved and all five conditions in clause 12.3.2 shall be satisfied, including STCW II/2 and A-II/2 certification, advanced polar training, watch coverage, rest compliance, and the condition-specific basic-training safeguards for designated officers.
requirement.requiredInputs: Administration permission, credentials, watch schedule, rest records, and operating ice condition
requirement.section: Part I-A Chapter 12 - Manning and training
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: The Administration may allow the use of a person(s) other than the master, chief mate or officers of the navigational watch to satisfy the requirements for training, provided that: this person(s) shall be qualified and certified in accordance with regulation II/2 of the STCW Convention and section A-II/2 of the STCW Code, and meet the advance training requirements set out in the table in paragraph 12.3.1; while operating in polar waters the ship carries a sufficient number of persons meeting the appropriate training requirements for polar waters to cover all watches; this person(s) is subject to the Administration's minimum hours of rest requirements at all times; when operating in waters other than open waters or bergy waters, the master, chief mate and officers in charge of a navigational watch on passenger ships and tankers shall meet the applicable basic training requirements set out in the table in paragraph 12.3.1; and when operating in waters with an ice concentration of more than 2/10, the master, chief mate and officers in charge of a navigational watch on cargo ships other than tankers shall meet the applicable basic training requirements set out in the table in paragraph 12.3.1.
